description: The input and output contract of each capability in the Agent Capability Standard ontology, rendered as JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 by the rules of STANDARD v1.2 §4.1.2. `$defs` holds `<capability>.input` and `<capability>.output`; the document itself constrains nothing.
